data.name: CricVRX - Virtual Cricket
data.description: An immersive VR cricket game with realistic physics, AI commentary, and multiple international stadiums. Features VR, Android TV, and 3D modes with a unique local casting system for multiplayer without internet.

data.name: Weather Forecasting for Formula 1 Racing Game
data.description: A machine learning solution for predicting weather conditions in the F1 2021 game. Features comparative analysis of Oracle Cloud ADS AutoML and Pycaret frameworks to determine how weather impacts race outcomes.

data.name: FlyVRX Fighter Jet TV
data.description: A 3D fighter jet action game for Android TV with multiple modes including Dogfight, Survival, Landing, and Takeoff. Features realistic aircraft physics, cockpit view, online multiplayer, and offline play capability.

data.name: MotoVRX
data.description: A complete motorcycle racing entertainment system featuring VR mode, Smart TV compatibility, and mobile gameplay. Includes first-person view, realistic bike physics, and RemoteVRX app for smartphone controller integration.

data.name: Last Day on Tower
data.description: A 1:1 scale 9D VR laser gun shooting simulator featuring a unique tower design with elevator, VR cinema, and multiplayer battle support. Includes special effects, vibration feedback, and high-resolution VR glasses.

data.name: Real Dinosaur RollerCoaster VR
data.description: A VR roller coaster simulator that combines thrilling rides with realistic dinosaur environments. Features high-resolution graphics, dynamic sound, and Google Cardboard compatibility for an immersive prehistoric experience.
